nodes.title: SG-7 Story Panel and Round status UI with real API integration
nodes.body:
Context: StoryPanel lacks the scene title, independent scroll and pixel-art styling. HeaderOverlay shows a bare 'Round unavailable: <msg>' with no retry. Desired behavior: a complete Story Panel and an explained, retryable round status header, both wired to existing state and the existing getCurrentRound client. Expected result: unit tests with the API mocked cover panel rendering, choice clicks and the round loading, success, empty and error states. Why: players need readable story context and a recoverable round status.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given game state, when StoryPanel renders, then it shows the scene title, dialogue, choices, history and inventory
- Given the Round API fails, when the header renders, then it explains the cause and offers a Retry button
- Given Retry is clicked and the API succeeds, when the request resolves, then the header shows round id, status and countdown
- Given no round exists (404), when the header renders, then it shows the distinct empty state, not an error


## Scope
- In scope: StoryPanel
- In scope: HeaderOverlay
- In scope: App round loading
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Phaser scene
- Out of scope: ContributionSheet
- Preserve: getCurrentRound API contract in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts
- Preserve: useGame state shape
- Preserve: No mock data in production code


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript + Tailwind
- Existing Go API client only


## Definition of done
- All requirements verified by unit tests with the API mocked


## Non-functional requirements
- Story panel scrolls independently without page scroll


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Story Panel shows scene title and scrolls independently in pixel-art styling
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/components/StoryPanel.tsx (L1-L47) renders dialogue, history and inventory but no scene title, and uses the unstyled 'story-content' class. Desired behavior: add a sceneTitle prop rendered as a heading, and wrap the content in a container that scrolls on its own with pixel-art Tailwind styling. Expected result: the panel shows all required story elements. Why: players need context for where they are.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given sceneTitle 'The Boys Room', when StoryPanel renders, then a heading with that text is shown
- Given a container, when the history is long, then the container has overflow-y-auto and a bounded height so it scrolls independently
- Given a dialogue node with two choices, when the second is clicked, then onChoose is called with 1


## Scope
- In scope: StoryPanel sceneTitle prop and styling
- Out of scope: GameLayout grid
- Out of scope: dialogue system logic
- Preserve: onChoose contract
- Preserve: aria-labels 'Dialogue', 'Story history', 'Inventory'
- Preserve: 'Empty' inventory text


## Technical constraints
- Tailwind classes only; pixel font via existing design tokens


## Definition of done
- StoryPanel renders scene title and scrolls independently


## Non-functional requirements
- Keyboard-accessible choice buttons


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Header explains round failure and offers Retry
nodes.body:
Context: HeaderOverlay.tsx (L1-L44) shows 'Round unavailable: {error}' only. Desired behavior: accept an optional onRetry prop and render a Retry button in the error state with explanatory text. Expected result: users can retry a failed round load. Why: avoid a dead-end error.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given error and onRetry, when rendered, then alert text includes the cause and a Retry button is shown
- When Retry is clicked, then onRetry is called once
- Given no error, then no Retry button is rendered


## Scope
- In scope: HeaderOverlay error state
- Out of scope: Countdown
- Preserve: Loading and empty states
- Preserve: Sound and Settings buttons


## Technical constraints
- Reuse ui/button


## Definition of done
- Retry rendered in error state only


## Non-functional requirements
- Alert uses role=alert


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · App loads the round from the Go API with explained errors, empty state and retry
nodes.body:
Context: App.tsx (L14-L28) calls getCurrentRound once and stores e.message. Desired behavior: a describeRoundError helper gives the cause (HTTP status, server detail, or network failure), a 404 yields the empty state, and a retry callback reloads and passes onRetry to HeaderOverlay. Backend CurrentRound returns 404 when no round exists (backend/internal/world/handler.go). Why: distinct states and recovery.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given getCurrentRound rejects ApiError 500, when App renders, then the alert explains 'Round service returned 500'
- Given it rejects ApiError 404, then 'No active round' is shown with no alert
- Given a failure then Retry click with success, then the round id and status appear
- Given a network TypeError, then the alert says the server could not be reached


## Scope
- In scope: App.tsx round loading
- Out of scope: client.ts changes
- Preserve: getCurrentRound signature


## Technical constraints
- No mock data in production code


## Definition of done
- Retry reloads the round


## Clarifying questions
- None
